description: This Dart source file defines configuration utilities for environment variables and a minimal API client placeholder for a Flutter application. It includes classes EnvConfig for managing environment-based configuration settings and ApiClient as a stub for network requests.

classes.name: EnvConfig
classes.description: Provides static getters to access environment variables such as API URL, WebSocket URL, feature flags, and Stripe keys.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A placeholder class representing an API client, with a generic get method that throws an unimplemented error, intended for future network request implementations.

methods.name: EnvConfig.apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or defaults to 'http://localhost:5001'.

methods.name: EnvConfig.wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket base URL from environment variables or defaults to 'ws://localhost:5001'.

methods.name: EnvConfig.useMocks
methods.description: Determines whether to use mock services based on environment variable FEATURE_USE_MOCKS, defaulting to true.

methods.name: EnvConfig.stripePublishableKey
methods.description: Fetches the Stripe publishable key from environment variables, defaulting to an empty string if not set.

methods.name: ApiClient.get
methods.description: A generic asynchronous method intended to perform HTTP GET requests. Currently throws an UnimplementedError.
